description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Oathkeeper, Takeno's Daisho
uses.cardState: attached to the creature with changeling
